body: I just received the “Salt of the Earth” Christian calendar, which organizes the year around the traditional Christian seasons (Advent, Christmas, Epiphany, Lent, Holy Week, Easter, Pentecost, Post-Pentecost). It will enrich my appreciation of “sacred time” in the year ahead. Info at www.thechristiancalendar.com.
